svg.title: Figure 5-9. Loss scenarios: inside openpilot, configuration and updates (§4.6) (WP-A-05 §5)
svg.desc: Figure 5-9: 10 loss scenario cards for inside openpilot, configuration and updates (§4.6). LS-23 (UCA-53, Covered): modeld or plannerd stops or lags while engaged. controlsd drops control when the plan is older than 0.5 s and raises commIssue, a soft disable. Plan or model output is held after its publisher stops. LS-24 (UCA-54, Covered): The panda revokes authority while selfdriveState is still engaged. Two pandaStates with controlsAllowed false give controlsMismatch, an immediate disable, within 0.5 s. 'Engaged' is shown while the panda grants nothing. LS-25 (UCA-55, Known gap): The external big model loads or warms up. selfdrived suppresses commIssue and the localizer checks. Control ends without a take-over alert. LS-26 (UCA-56, Known gap): After a tyre, alignment or load change, paramsd and torqued learn wrong values. They are bounded only to 0.5–2× the platform value; the panda bounds the torque, not the tracking. The car under- or over-steers in curves within the envelope. LS-27 (UCA-50, UCA-57, Known gap): The device moves on its windscreen mount by less than the recalibration threshold. The model output keeps its confidence. The path is biased within the envelope. LS-28 (UCA-59, Covered): A pandad defect or a compromised SoC requests a mode change while driving, or asserts reset or BOOT0. The panda refuses mode changes in a car mode, but not the reset and BOOT0 lines. Control ends with the SoC's own alert only. LS-29 (UCA-60, Covered): A release bundles a panda image built without the reference flag, or a rollback brings an older one. pandad flashes it, then refuses a car mode; a DEBUG image with the flag set would pass. The panda runs firmware other than the reference build. LS-30 (UCA-61, Known gap): The owner installs from the upstream installer or a development branch. Nothing checks for an approved release; it is logged, but the driver is not told. Software that is not an approved release drives. LS-31 (UCA-62, Covered): ExperimentalMode defaulted to on at v0.3. A device not set up per the release instructions starts in Experimental Mode. The driving mode is set outside the reference configuration. LS-34 (UCA-63, Covered): On a radar-ACC platform, alpha longitudinal disables the stock radar ECU over UDS. That turns PCS off; since v0.4 card refuses the alpha request on any vehicle. The stock radar, and with it PCS/AEB, is silenced.
svg.text: Loss scenarios · inside openpilot, configuration and updates (§4.6)
How each unsafe control action comes about: the cause, what the controller believes or never learns, and the action on the road.
Steps: 1 the cause · 2 named after the scenario's causal-factor type · 3 the unsafe control action
UCA-53: Plan or model output held after its publisher stops or lags
Covered (#51); commIssue stays a soft disable (LS-20)
The panda revokes, the screen says engaged
UCA-54: latActive/longActive provided while the panda does not grant authority,
or while the PCM cruise state differs
Covered (#51); not verified on the vehicle
UCA-55: Disengagement not provided when a supervised input is invalid, because
Exclusion decided; the engagement guard is not implemented
UCA-56: Learned steer ratio, stiffness, angle offset or lateral acceleration factor
applied while wrong; bounded only to 0.5–2× the platform value (paramsd.py:47)
CC-10 has no requirement; bounds need vehicle data
The device moved on its mount
UCA-50: Desired curvature or acceleration provided from a degraded input
(occluded or blinded camera, calibration invalid or wrong) with no drop in the …
UCA-59: ELM327, power save, a mode change or a reset/boot-mode request

svg.text: Covered for commands; known gap for reset and BOOT0
(GAP-38), and for an ELM327 request after a false ignition-off
from the harness (DFA DFI-08, DM-24 required)
The wrong panda image in a release
UCA-60: Panda flashed with firmware other than the assured reference build (the
bundled image is wrong, or a rollback brings an older one)
Covered for a non-reference image (item unavailable, safe);
known gap for a DEBUG reference image (PFM-001)
UCA-61: Update installed that is not an approved LionDriver release, or that
Signed releases and installer not built
Experimental Mode from an old setup
UCA-62: Driving mode or toggles set outside the reference configuration

Alpha longitudinal knocks out the radar
UCA-63: ECU knockout or alpha longitudinal provided on a vehicle, silencing the

SFM-033, PFM-011; LD-FSR-001; change record CA-001

Steps paraphrase the §5 row; each quotes a phrase of it (or of the UCA), checked at build. Status and 'open because' from stpa-map.yaml.
